newsitem.title: INDIA: India's RBI resumes dlr purchase in swap market.
newsitem.headline: India's RBI resumes dlr purchase in swap market.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Wednesday resumed buying dollars in the forward market, dealers said.
"They have not yet hit in a big way as they did on Friday," said a dealer. "They are hitting selectively - maybe they are looking for a particular level for August."
RBI was buying spot August dollars at 1.31/1.33 rupees, dealers said. August dollars had opened at 1.32/1.35 rupees.
RBI was not active on Tuesday but bought over $75 million in swap deals on Friday, they said.
RBI was buying dollars ahead of the redemption of India Development Bonds (IDBs) which could require an outlay of as much as $1.0 billion, dealers said.
